messages:
ana (People Ops): Hi team — launching a short 'Signal Playbook' template to standardize how we capture evidence for OKRs and self-reviews. Preview: https://go.redwood/signal-playbook. It's meant to be low-friction and useful for promotion calibration.
drew (Eng): Nice. Does this replace our other one-pagers or sit next to them?
karen (PM): Side-by-side. Playbook gives a rubric: what counts as high-quality evidence and quick manager language to use during reviews.
nana (People Ops): (small correction) ana: The core idea: capture the metric/ artifact, how it was measured, confidence level, and why it matters for customers or product. Keep it to 1-2 lines per item.
mike (Manager): Can we see the manager phrases? want to copy-paste into review comments.
nana (People Ops): Sure  examples in the doc under "Manager Quick Phrases":
- Praise: "Clear metric + artifact link. Thanks — could you add the experiment/PR ID for traceability?"
- Clarify: "This is promising; please add the sampling window and segmentation used for the metric."
- Calibration nudge: "Strong signal; for calibration please add user-scale numbers and whether this was rolled to prod."
drew (Eng): What about cross-team artifacts? who owns validation when the data lives in another org?
nana (People Ops): Add the artifact and tag the owning team in the owner field. Manager should add a verification note (e.g., 'validated with data team on 2026-04-10'). We added a tiny verification checklist in the playbook.
karen (PM): Timeline: continuous vs fill at check-ins?
review-bot: Reminder: Mid-cycle snapshot date 2026-05-01. People Ops recommends ongoing updates with a formal snapshot on the check-in date.
mike (Manager): For promotion packets, will evidence from the playbook be used directly?
nana (People Ops): Yes — evidence tiers map to packet recommendations. We added a short mapping: High-confidence evidence (metrics + artifact + reproducible query) -> supports impact claims; Medium -> needs corroboration; Low -> considered anecdotal.
drew (Eng): Any automation planned to pull PRs/dashboards into the playbook?
nana (People Ops): We're prototyping a small parser that detects dashboard/PR links and pulls title + date into the row. No ETA but we'll share alpha soon.
karen (PM): Can managers request a condensed export for calibration?
nana (People Ops): Yes  created a CSV export view with columns: objective, KR, evidence, confidence, owner, artifact link, manager note. Ping me if you want early access.
mike (Manager): I'll pilot with my leads and ask for one evidence row per top KR by next Tuesday.
nana (People Ops): Thank you! If anyone wants a 15-min walkthrough or a paste-ready phrase pack for different seniority levels, DM me and I'll drop into your sync. :raised_hands:
